root_cause.text: In mtype_del(), the bucket release condition only checked if both n->pos and k were zero, failing to free buckets where all entries have been deleted but n->pos still points past removed slots, leaving logically empty buckets uncollected.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that "mtype_del() counts empty slots below n->pos in k, but it only drops the bucket when both n->pos and k are zero. This misses buckets whose live entries have all been removed while n->pos still points past deleted slots." The patch changes the condition from `if (n->pos == 0 && k == 0)` to `if (k == n->pos)`, confirming the fix.
